sources.snippet: IgFold utilizes a novel approach to train a natural language model on 558M natural antibody sequences to predict structures that are more accurate than AlphaFold (and faster!) Running IgFold on COSMIC² To run IgFold: Create a plain text file that has two entries: H & L. Upload this file using the web browser upload Click through tool creation.
